catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.subtitle: Products, categories and locations shown on the website. Changes go live immediately.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: Each category is a product family with its own page. New categories are published at /dedicados/<slug>.
categories.confirmDelete: Delete this category? It must have no products.

products.title: Products
products.hint: The plans customers can order. The price is the monthly price in euros.
products.empty: No products in this category yet.
products.confirmDelete: Delete this product? It will disappear from the website and from any cart holding it.

locations.title: VPS locations
locations.hint: Regions where a VPS can be deployed, each with its page at /vps/<slug>.
locations.confirmDelete: Delete this location? Its page will stop working.

form.name: Name
form.badgeHint: Small mono text above the title, e.g. “🇫🇷 Paris · bare metal”.
form.slugHint: Leave empty to derive it from the name. It is normalised and made unique on save.
form.priceHint: Euros per month. Customers see it converted if they pick USD.
form.noteHint: Shown next to the city, e.g. “< 5 ms to Western Europe”.
form.mapHint: 0–100 over the Europe map on the homepage.
form.planId: Plan id: {id} — fixed, it is used by order URLs and issued invoices.
form.langHint: English is required. Anything left empty falls back to English.
form.regionCpuHint: Processor brand shown on this region’s VPS cards, e.g. “Xeon Gold 6150”. Empty = use the plan’s own.
form.provisionLocationHint: Location slug in the provisioning module (e.g. “nl-ams”). This is what connects the region to Proxmox. Empty = manual delivery.

errors.generico: The change could not be saved.
errors.datos: Fill in at least the English name.
errors.no-encontrado: That entry no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.categoria-con-productos: Delete or move its products first.
errors.categoria-vps-protegida: The VPS family cannot be deleted: /vps depends on it.

clienteDetalle.resetPasswordDescription: Assign a new password to this customer. You don't need the previous one; enter it twice to confirm.

facturas.heading: Invoices
facturas.noInvoices: You haven't issued any invoices yet. Create the first one above.

filters.dateFieldHint: For tax filings, use the payment date: that is when the fiscal number is assigned.
filters.results: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices in this selection} one {# invoice selected} other {# invoices selected}}
filters.noResults: No invoices match this filter. Widen the date range or change the status.
filters.downloadHint: One PDF per invoice plus resumen.csv.
filters.downloadError: The download could not be prepared. Please try again.

facturaPrint.footerThanks: Thank you for trusting {brand}. Invoice generated electronically; valid without a signature.
facturaPrint.proformaNote: Proforma document, not a final invoice. A final invoice will be issued once payment is confirmed.

invoiceActions.payError: The payment link could not be generated.

invoiceForm.emailSent: Proforma emailed to the customer with the PDF attached.
invoiceForm.emailNotSent: The proforma was created, but it could not be emailed to the customer.

resetPasswordForm.errorRequirements: The password does not meet the requirements.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Payment gateway and integration keys.
settings.stripeIntro: Card payments. Charges and invoices remain in euros.
settings.modeLiveWarning: you are in live mode: charges are real.
settings.keysIntro: Stored on the server, outside git and readable only by root. They are never shown in full again.
settings.secretKeyHint: In Stripe: Developers → API keys → secret key (sk_…). Not the publishable one (pk_…).
settings.webhookSecretHint: Stripe gives it to you when you create the webhook endpoint (whsec_…).
settings.keepHint: Saved. Leave empty to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
settings.errorSave: The settings could not be saved.
settings.webhookIntro: Add this URL in Stripe (Developers → Webhooks) and paste the signing secret it gives you above.
settings.providerIntro: API access to the provider that hosts the VPS, so customers can manage theirs from here.
settings.providerUrlHint: Base address including the version, e.g. https://manage.v4vm.com/api/v1
settings.providerTokenHint: Create it at the provider under Account → API tokens.
settings.providerWarning: This token can power off, reinstall and delete servers. It never leaves the server and is never shown again once saved.
settings.providerTokenExpiryHint: Tokens from /auth/login only last 15 minutes. Create a permanent one under Account → API tokens and paste that one instead.

servidores.title: Servers
servidores.subtitle: Everything you have at the provider, and which customer each one belongs to.
servidores.heading: Inventory
servidores.notConfigured: No provider API token yet. Add it under Settings and the inventory will show up here.
servidores.none: There are no servers in this account yet.
servidores.orphansIntro: These were assigned to a customer but no longer exist at the provider. Removing the link does not touch anything at the provider.
servidores.errorLoad: The server list could not be loaded.
servidores.errorSave: The assignment could not be saved.

external.heading: External servers
external.intro: Machines from other providers, with no API to query. You add them by hand and their only source of data is the agent installed inside.
external.name: Name

agente.heading: Metrics agent
agente.statusActive: Token active since {fecha}. If the agent is already installed, there is nothing to do.
agente.statusNone: No token yet. Generate one to install the agent on this machine and see its usage.
agente.revokeConfirm: The installed agent will stop reporting immediately. Continue?
agente.once: This token is shown once. Copy it now: afterwards you can only generate another one.
agente.copyError: Could not copy; select it by hand.
agente.help: Works on any Linux with systemd or cron. It installs no packages, opens no ports, and is removed with «sudo /usr/local/bin/viahost-agent --uninstall».
agente.deleteExternal: Delete this server from the panel
agente.deleteConfirm: The record and its whole metrics history are deleted. The machine itself is untouched. Continue?

tickets.title: Support tickets
tickets.subtitle: Everything customers have opened from their account area.
tickets.subtitlePending: {count, plural, one {# ticket waiting for an answer} other {# tickets waiting for an answer}}.

detail.replyHint: You can also reply to the email in soporte@viahost.top: it reaches the customer and the reply lands in this thread on its own.
detail.replyPlaceholder: Write the reply the customer will receive…
detail.mailFailed: Saved in the thread, but the notification email could not be sent.
detail.errorSend: The action failed. Please try again.

avisos.heading: Threshold alerts
avisos.intro: An email when a machine with an agent crosses a threshold, and another when it recovers. A threshold of 0 turns that rule off.
avisos.errorSave: The alerts could not be saved.

help.disco: Reported as soon as it is crossed: if the disk is full, it is full.
help.sostenido: Applies to CPU and memory, so a one-minute spike does not send email.
help.agenteCaido: 0 means no alert when a machine stops reporting.
help.destinatarios: Comma separated. Left blank, they go to administrador@viahost.top.

avisos.openHeading: {count, plural, one {# open alert} other {# open alerts}}
